THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
020
STUDY 026
Black Knit & Dark Studio Gradient
Rights check
Source: 24573.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair pulled back at
the crown rests one arm across her forehead, with the
other arm extended toward the lens. She wears a fitted
black long-sleeve knit with a high neck. Her lips are
warm coral, and her expression is calm and direct. A
deep charcoal backdrop with soft gradient light falls off
into shadow. Low-key studio lighting, a palette of
charcoal, black, and warm coral. Dramatic and sleek, in
the style of a beauty campaign.
Dramatic, sleek, moody
WORKING NOTES
- The coral lip is the only warm accent against the dark
tones.
- Add 'dramatic side lighting' to sharpen the cheekbones.
Try this: Add dramatic side lighting.
